description_en: Lists the run history of a migration task
description_zh: 列举迁移任务运行历史
name: ListJobHistory

parameters.help_en: The name of the migration task whose run history to retrieve
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en: The execution ID of a specific run. Specify this parameter to retrieve the run history for only that execution
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行ID。指定执行ID，只会list该执行ID的运行历史
parameters.name: runtime_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the marker value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page of results. If not specified, results are returned from the beginning
parameters.help_zh:
设定从该marker之后列举任务运行历史。  
默认值：无
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of history entries to return.
Valid values: 1 to 1000.
Default value: 1000.
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回迁移任务历史的数量。  
取值：大于0小于等于1000  
默认值：1000
parameters.name: count

JobHistoryList.description_en: The list of task run history entries
